detect_adsorbate_dissociation: create a DetectTrajAnomaly instance and call is_adsorbate_dissociated to check if adsorbate connectivity changed during relaxation
detect_surface_reconstruction: create a DetectTrajAnomaly instance and call has_surface_changed to detect bond breaking or forming on the surface
detect_adsorbate_desorption: create a DetectTrajAnomaly instance and call is_adsorbate_desorbed to check if the adsorbate has detached from the slab
detect_adsorbate_intercalation: create a DetectTrajAnomaly instance and call is_adsorbate_intercalated to check if adsorbate neighbors a frozen atom
get_connectivity_matrix: use DetectTrajAnomaly _get_connectivity method to generate a connectivity matrix for an ASE Atoms object
